newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Perlis gets nod to list unit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Perlis gets nod to list unit.

text.p: Perlis Plantations Bhd has received the Securities Commission's aproval on the proposed merger and listing of its East Malaysia-based plantation firms under a newly incorporated holding company, PPB Oil Palms Bhd (PPB).

Perlis said in a statement issued late on Tuesday that the commission has approved the public offering of 55.94 million PPB shares at 2.80 ringgit per share and listing of the entire paid-up capital of 418.179 million shares on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board.

Perlis said the Securities Commission also approved the transfer of the entire paid-up share capital of Sandakan Edible Oils Sdn Bhd from Sapi Plantations Sdn Bhd to PPB at 11 million ringgit as proposed.

The approval, however, is subject to the proceeds of the public issue of 156.62 million ringgit being used for repayment of bank borrowings, acquisition of fixed assets, plantation development and estimated listing expenses.
